findings.what: The public source declares ram_ffd8dc[40] without marking that capacity as unproved. The author explicitly acknowledges in the private manifest that 40 is only a sufficient matching bound. Independently changing it to 41 still MATCHes both revisions. Observed paired queue accesses and the counter at 0xffd92e do not uniquely establish an original declaration of exactly 40 words.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an inline [INFERENCE] comment distinguishing the observed word-element layout from the unproved capacity. Retain a bounded declaration unless additional evidence supports a different extent; do not present matching alone as proof of 40.

findings.what: The name frame_count misdescribes the temporary holding (distance >> 7) + 192: that value divides the maximum fixed-point distance, and the resulting distance is subsequently the common divisor used to normalize the four coordinate deltas. [INFERENCE] nominal_step is a closer semantic name; the temporary itself is ordinary and removing it yields a two-byte-shorter nonmatch in both revisions.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename frame_count to a neutral arithmetic name such as distance_divisor, or to nominal_step with an appropriately qualified explanation. Update the author's public idiom wording if it describes this value as a proved frame count. Do not remove the temporary merely to shorten the source.

findings.what: The header comment says terrain 0x80/0x90 is returned outside the map, but the original bounds tests reject zero map coordinates and coordinates above the upper bounds, not negative map coordinates. The packet has signed BGT/BLE tests at 0x00da46/0x00da50; a negative nonzero map coordinate follows the lookup path. [INFERENCE] Normal callers may rely on a nonnegative-coordinate precondition; that precondition was not proved by this review, and no reachable gameplay defect is claimed.
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the exact observed zero/upper-bound tests, or explicitly qualify the comment with the nonnegative-world-coordinate assumption. Preserve the original condition; if negative-coordinate handling is later established as an original bug, annotate it ORIGINAL BUG rather than silently correcting it.
